title: Local desktop smoke
target: Instrumented local GUI with isolated Qt runtime

cases.title: Owned GUI connection
cases.expected: Owned process, endpoint and Golden Project agree.

cases.title: CLI edit reaches the editor
cases.expected: Renamed timeline appears in selector and Media.

cases.title: Play, pause and seek
cases.expected: Transport advances, visible timecode follows, pause holds.

cases.title: Save the project
cases.expected: Save updates the persisted project without changing its contents.

cases.title: Quit and reopen
cases.expected: A new process restores the saved timeline and selection.

cases.title: Media list and grid
cases.expected: Both views retain the same GP media.

cases.title: Select and open media
cases.expected: The selected source opens with the correct duration.

cases.title: Open timelines from Media
cases.expected: Opening each timeline changes the visible selected timeline.

cases.title: Playback shortcuts
cases.expected: Arrow keys step a frame; Space plays and pauses.

cases.title: Tools and snapping
cases.expected: Tool shortcuts select the named tool; snapping toggles and restores.

cases.title: Split, undo and redo
cases.expected: Split at two seconds produces contiguous source windows and valid exact timing; undo and redo restore the corresponding states.
steps: The first video clip is selected and the playhead is at 00:00:02:00. Press B once.
Check that the first clip becomes two adjacent clips at the playhead. Play across the cut and look for a jump or blank frame.
Press Command+Z, then Command+Shift+Z. Confirm the original clip and then the two pieces return.
Record whether the visible edit worked. Use Capture diagnostics to retain the underlying timing state; visual success alone cannot clear the metadata finding.

cases.title: Delete and undo
cases.expected: Only the selected clip is removed; undo restores all content.

cases.title: Disable a clip
cases.expected: The selected clip is disabled and undo restores it.

cases.title: Nudge one frame
cases.expected: Clip moves exactly one frame without changing its source window.

cases.title: Drag a timeline clip
cases.expected: Clip moves on a frame boundary without changing duration or neighbors.

cases.title: Trim and undo
cases.expected: Right-edge trimming changes matching timeline/source durations, preserves the other edge and maintains valid exact timing.
steps: The first video clip is selected. On the timeline, drag its right edge left to shorten it by roughly one second.
Confirm the left edge and the following clip remain in place. Play the shortened clip and inspect its end.
Press Command+Z to restore it, then Command+Shift+Z to restore the trim.
Record the visible result and Capture diagnostics. The automated finding concerns timing metadata as well as the visible edit.

cases.title: Add and save tracks
cases.expected: Clicking + Video or + Audio, followed by Save, adds one empty track of the correct type to persisted project state; undo restores the original tracks.
steps: In the Timeline panel header above the tracks, click + Video once. Look for a new empty video track.
Capture diagnostics before saving. The earlier automated failure checked persisted state before Save; a visible track can exist while that readback remains unchanged.
Press Command+S, then Capture diagnostics again. Check whether the added video track now appears in persisted state.
Press Command+Z, then Command+S. Confirm the original track count returns. Record whether this is a UI defect, persistence defect, or an automation expectation problem.

cases.title: Cancel closing an unsaved project
cases.expected: Cancel keeps the app open and retains the unsaved edit.

cases.title: Search media
cases.expected: Searching for pattern_24 finds the known clip; clearing search restores all items.
steps: In the Media panel, enter pattern_24 in Search and press Return.
Record the result rows and any status message, including Search unavailable. Do not install models or change personal credentials.
Clear the query and confirm the original media list returns. Capture diagnostics and record a setup blocker if search is unavailable.

cases.title: Cancel export
cases.expected: Cancel closes the dialog without producing output or changing the project.

cases.title: Copy, paste and undo
cases.expected: Paste makes an independent clip with matching source; undo restores the timeline.

cases.title: Inspector edit and reset
cases.expected: Position X changes parameters and rendered pixels; reset restores both.

cases.title: H.264 movie export
cases.expected: Export produces a decodable two-second 1080p24 movie with 48 frames and AAC audio.

cases.title: Local motion graphics
cases.expected: Local graphics render, and changing the title changes pixels without a network provider.

cases.title: Fresh default panels
cases.expected: Fresh isolated launch exposes Media, Preview, Timeline and Agent Workspace controls.

cases.title: Application and project preferences
cases.expected: Application and Current Project pages open; Cancel leaves the project unchanged.

cases.title: Fullscreen playback and exit
cases.expected: Fullscreen controls advance and pause transport; Escape restores the normal preview.

cases.title: Select all clips
cases.expected: Select All followed by Delete removes every clip; one undo restores all content. Track targeting is separate.

cases.title: Cut, paste and undo
cases.expected: Real clipboard cut/paste retains source and requested placement; two undos restore the timeline.

cases.title: Rebind and reset a shortcut
cases.expected: A temporary play/pause binding works; per-command Reset restores Space and its behavior.

cases.title: Create spells through the editor
cases.expected: Opening Spellbook, its New Spell shortcut and plus button produce independent visible documents.

cases.title: Author and wire a native Spell
cases.expected: Source and two effect nodes connect, disconnect and reconnect through application operations. No rendering or output publication is implied.

cases.title: Edit a native Spell parameter
cases.expected: A CLI radius edit is retained in native parameter readback. Inspector gesture and canvas pixels remain separate.

cases.title: Bypass and restore a Spell node
cases.expected: Application operations toggle and restore bypass state. The D shortcut remains separate.

cases.title: Atomic Spell undo and redo
cases.expected: One real keyboard undo reverts a multi-action batch; redo restores the whole change.

cases.title: Reject a partial Spell edit
cases.expected: A batch with an invalid edge rejects every action and preserves the complete prior document.

cases.title: Reject a stale Spell edit
cases.expected: An outdated document fingerprint cannot overwrite a newer edit.

cases.title: Independent Spell instance
cases.expected: An instance overrides exposed inputs without changing the definition; later edits remain independent. Tab rename/close is separate.

cases.title: Save and reopen Spellbook
cases.expected: A new GUI process restores authored graphs, native parameters, public inputs and independent instances.

cases.title: Quick-search node insertion
cases.expected: Quick Node Search finds Text; double-click creates a Text node in the active graph; undo restores the graph. Drag/drop is separate.

cases.title: Cross-rate GUI copy and paste
cases.expected: Copy from 24 fps and paste at 25 fps preserves exact source time, independent identity and placement; undo restores the destination.

cases.title: Play a secondary timeline and switch
cases.expected: A non-entry timeline advances visible transport; switching selects Main and its timecode responds to seek. Seamless output continuity is separate.

cases.title: Scope plots respond at each tap
cases.expected: Histogram, luma/RGB waveform and RGB parade plots change between a video frame and black gap at each available tap. Numerical calibration and vectorscope are separate.

cases.title: Verbose Spellbook console
cases.expected: Enable project-local verbose logging, reconstruct the native graph and observe debug messages in the visible console; restore the previous setting.

cases.title: Convert a clip through the editor
cases.expected: Command+G creates a child timeline reference with the same source, placement and rendered pixels.

cases.title: Edit inside a converted timeline and return
cases.expected: Opening the child from Media and disabling its clip changes parent pixels; undo restores them.

cases.title: Keyboard copy and paste of an MGFX clip
cases.expected: Command+C/V creates an independent generation; parameter edits change only copied values and pixels.

cases.title: Export MGFX and a converted timeline
cases.expected: The application Export dialog publishes 96 decodable frames; graphic and converted-media segments contain their expected imagery.

cases.title: Dissolve a converted timeline and undo
cases.expected: Command+Shift+G restores media placements without changing pixels; one undo restores the timeline reference.

cases.title: Export Still at Playhead through the dialog
cases.expected: The JPEG decodes at 1080p and corresponds to the selected one-second playhead frame.

cases.title: Linked Selection moves the intended streams
cases.expected: With Linked Selection on, nudging selected video moves its linked audio. With it off, only video moves. Undo restores both.

cases.title: Track padlock blocks blade and drag
cases.expected: The visible padlock prevents blade and drag edits; unlocking allows a move, and undo restores the original clip.

cases.title: V1/A1 targeting controls Select All
cases.expected: Target badges determine which tracks Select All/Delete affects. Untargeted clips remain unchanged and undo restores targeted clips.

cases.title: Ripple-delete a selected gap
cases.expected: Shift+Delete removes the two-second gap, moves the next clip from six seconds to four without changing its source, and undo restores the gap.

cases.title: Rename media without breaking placed clips
cases.expected: Bin Rename changes the saved display name while preserving identity, source bytes and rendered placements; restoration survives reopen.

cases.title: Duplicate media with an independent name
cases.expected: Bin Duplicate mints a new asset for the same media. Renaming it preserves the original, and both identities/names survive reopen.

cases.title: Delete from bin and undo
cases.expected: Bin deletion hides the asset without removing its source or breaking placed clips. Undo restores its identity, including after reopen.

cases.title: Duplicate MGFX through the bin menu
cases.expected: Bin Duplicate creates independent generation state. Editing copied text changes only copied values/pixels, which survive reopen.

cases.title: Slip a clip through the editor
cases.expected: The Slip gesture changes the source window without changing placement or duration; exact source timing remains valid and undo restores it.

cases.title: Link and unlink through the editor
cases.expected: The link/unlink shortcut changes groups; unlinked video moves alone and relinked streams move together.

cases.title: Blade with nothing selected
cases.expected: Blade cuts both streams at the playhead with contiguous source windows and valid exact timing; undo restores the original.

cases.title: Fractional-rate GUI copy and paste
cases.expected: Copy 24 frames at 24000/1001 to frames 3-33 at 30000/1001 with independent identity, unchanged source time and working undo.

cases.title: Timeline tab zoom and scroll restoration
cases.expected: Closing and reopening a saved timeline tab restores content, zoom and horizontal scroll.

cases.title: Clean close and discard unsaved edits
cases.expected: Save allows a clean close without a dirty prompt. Discard removes an unsaved edit, and a fresh process restores the saved project.

cases.title: Render-node clipboard and bypass
cases.expected: Actual Copy/Paste Nodes preserves independent values and pixels. D toggles the selected node and the grade-panel bypass restores expected pixels.

cases.title: Document formatting, chip and reopen
cases.expected: Keyboard bold/link formatting and an @ chip survive save and a fresh process. The current build uses a fixture mention registry; live project-item resolution is separate.

cases.title: Scrubber drag and displayed frame
cases.expected: Actual scrubber drags land within one frame and display pixels matching an independent seek, including a black gap.

cases.title: Mark, navigate and clear In/Out
cases.expected: I/O mark frame boundaries; Shift+I/O navigate to them and Alt+X clears both.

cases.title: Loop the marked range
cases.expected: An application-owned loop control repeatedly plays the marked range. Blocked when this build exposes no loop control.

cases.title: Scrub across twenty cuts
cases.expected: Back-and-forth jumps across twenty alternating colour/grayscale clips show the correct settled preview, never stale or black content.

cases.title: Rename, close and reopen a Spell tab
cases.expected: Actual tab rename and close/reopen retain graph content and name, including across a fresh application process.

cases.title: Duplicate a Spell tab
cases.expected: An application-owned duplicate-tab action creates independent state. Instances do not substitute for tab duplication.

cases.title: Drop a quick-search result onto the canvas
cases.expected: Wizard produces the drag payload; its Qt drop handler creates a Text node and one undo restores the graph. Does not claim OS pointer drag coverage.

cases.title: Inspector edit, undo and canvas preview
cases.expected: The real Inspector edits native state with one-step undo and updates rendered canvas pixels. Keep blocked until both state and pixel observations are available.

cases.title: Relink moved local media
cases.expected: Reopen with a moved disposable source, use Locate/Relink, preserve asset and clip identity, restore rendering, and retain the new path after restart. No NAS.

cases.title: RGB curve gesture, copy/paste and reset
cases.expected: A curve drag changes pixels; keyboard copy/paste transfers curve points and pixels to a second clip; resetting the copy leaves the original unchanged.

cases.title: Hue curve gesture and reset
cases.expected: A Hue Shift curve drag changes native points and pixels; double-click reset restores neutral rendering.

cases.title: Export a timeline with an unset rate
cases.expected: A disposable fixture with stored timeline rate 0/1 resolves to 24/1 and exports 48 decodable H.264 frames; a 1 fps fallback must fail this check.
